name: Focused Channeling
body:
You can channel energy as a focused beam.

Prerequisite: Directed Channeling, channel energy class feature.

Benefit: When channeling energy, you may change its area of effect to a 120 ft. line.

Normal: Channeling positive or negative energy is a 30 ft. burst.

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
